2609.30469.title: Pretrained ASR Pseudo-labeling for Noisy Police Audio
2609.30469.paper_summary: Pretrained ASR systems perform poorly on noisy Broadcast Police Communication (BPC), hindering efforts to understand police decision-making. Pseudo-labeling offers an unsupervised path to improve ASR without expensive human labels, but the efficacy of this approach on very noisy domains is not known. In this work, we systematically assess the opportunities and limits of pseudo-labeling to adapt foundation ASR models (Whisper and Qwen3-ASR) to noisy BPC domain corpora from Baltimore and Chicago. We demonstrate that existing internal confidence metrics (log-probabilities and STAR scores) fail to distinguish between high and low quality BPC pseudo-labels, and we introduce an external LLM-as-a-judge filtering paradigm that leverages parametric knowledge to discard contextually implausible transcripts. Our LLM-judging filters more aggressively than internal metrics and significantly reduces WER of the pseudo-labeled training sets across the Baltimore and Chicago BPC corpora, though a substantial gap remains relative to an oracle filter. We also introduce a new cross-model pseudo-labeling paradigm where one model is finetuned with pseudo-labels from the other, and we identify this method as a promising direction for future pseudo-labeling work.
2609.30469.paper_summary_zh: 預訓練的自動語音識別系統在嘈雜的廣播警察通訊（BPC）上表現不佳，妨礙了對警察決策過程的理解。偽標記提供了一條無需昂貴人類標籤的無監督改進自動語音識別的途徑，但這種方法在非常嘈雜的領域中的有效性尚不清楚。在本研究中，我們系統地評估了偽標記的機會和限制，以適應來自巴爾的摩和芝加哥的嘈雜BPC領域語料庫的基礎自動語音識別模型（Whisper和Qwen3-ASR）。我們展示了現有的內部信心指標（對數概率和STAR分數）無法區分高質量和低質量的BPC偽標記，並引入了一種外部LLM作為評判的過濾範式，利用參數知識來丟棄在上下文中不合情理的轉錄。我們的LLM評判過濾器比內部指標更具侵略性，並顯著降低了巴爾的摩和芝加哥BPC語料庫中偽標記訓練集的字錯誤率（WER），儘管相對於一個神諭過濾器仍然存在顯著差距。我們還引入了一種新的跨模型偽標記範式，其中一個模型使用來自另一個模型的偽標記進行微調，我們將這種方法確定為未來偽標記工作的有前景方向。
